name: Kul Tiras
summary: Across the Great Sea, Kul Tiras keeps to its island waters west of Dun Morogh and Baradin Bay. Its navy once anchored the Alliance of Lordaeron. Since that alliance fractured and losses came in Kalimdor, the kingdom has drawn back.

sections.title: A Nation Born of the Sea
sections.body: Kul Tiras rose to power on the work of its merchant marine and the wealth of its fishing grounds. Its naval armada had no equal in human history.

sections.title: The Second War and Isolation
sections.body:
When the Orcish Horde swept through the Eastern Kingdoms, Kul Tiras answered King Terenas Menethil II and joined the Alliance of Lordaeron. Lord Admiral Daelin Proudmoore commanded humanity's naval forces. They fought across the open ocean to cut the Horde's sea lanes and guard the coasts.

After the war, the northern kingdoms eventually split. Kul Tiras drew back its fleets, strengthened its coastal defenses, and kept to itself.

sections.title: Shadows over the Proudmoores
sections.body: Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore sailed to Kalimdor in search of Lady Jaina Proudmoore. She had led refugees across the ocean to build Theramore. Daelin then began a campaign against the Horde. The crusade brought ruin, and Daelin died at Theramore.

faq.answer: Kul Tiras lies in the Great Sea, west of Baradin Bay and the coast of Dun Morogh. Its rugged, cold, mountainous islands are guarded by massive seawalls and heavy coastal garrisons.

faq.q: Is Kul Tiras still part of the Alliance?
faq.answer: Kul Tiras helped found the Alliance of Lordaeron. Since the old Alliance splintered, the kingdom has largely withdrawn from continental affairs and keeps itself apart.
Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore led Kul Tiras for decades. His campaign in Kalimdor ended with his death at Theramore.

faq.q: Why is Kul Tiras famous across Azeroth?
aliases: what is kul tiras known for
faq.answer: Kul Tiras is famed for its maritime fleet, shipwrights, and sailors, the greatest in the known world. Its warships and vast merchant convoys dominated the sea lanes for centuries. Its navy helped hold off the Horde in the Second War.

faq.q: How is Kul Tiras connected to Jaina Proudmoore?
faq.answer: Lady Jaina Proudmoore is Kul Tiran and the daughter of Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore. Born to the ruling family, she studied in Dalaran, then established the independent port of Theramore Isle on Kalimdor. In doing so, she distanced herself from her homeland's leadership.
Beyond their deep enmity with the Horde, Kul Tiras faces renegade pirate crews and hostile coastal beasts in its waters. Constant watch and fortified seagates protect the shipping lanes.

angles.text: At sea, the Alliance of Lordaeron relied on the Kul Tiran armada to survive. After the losses of the Third War, the island nation keeps its distance and remains guarded.
Kul Tiran sailors under Admiral Proudmoore fought bitterly against the Horde in the Second War. Later, they attacked Thrall's new homeland in Durotar, deepening an enduring blood feud.
As a human, you can trace Kul Tiras's hardy island culture to its shipbuilding, trade, and resilience against the open ocean.
As a miner, you know Kul Tiras's shipyards use great quantities of metal to build the armored warships of Azeroth's mightiest navy.
